meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发布前自动审查代码变更，确保质量达标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在npm发布前需要多维度自动化代码审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review code changes before release to ensure quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent automated code review before npm publish

howto.what: 装上后,你要求做发布前审查,Claude 会先找出自上次 npm 发布以来的所有改动,再派最多16个子代理分别检查每个改动、整体质量、发布风险,最后给你报告:各改动是否通过、有无破坏性变更、建议版本号、变更日志草稿。
howto.when: 当你说"pre-publish review"、"ready to publish?"、"safe to publish"等明确要求发布前检查的话时触发;只是普通说"发布"不会触发。

say.text: 帮我做个发布前审查,现在能发布吗?
say.note: Claude 会启动全部审查流程并给出报告。

say.text: 请运行 pre-publish review,检查这次更新有没有破坏性变更。
say.note: 重点看破坏性变更和版本号建议。

say.text: 明天要发 npm 包,先做一次 pre-release review。
say.note: 会检查自上次发布以来的所有改动。

howto.what_en: After install, asking for a pre-publish review makes Claude find all changes since the last npm publish, spawn up to 16 background agents for per-change, holistic, and release-level analysis, then give a report: verdicts, risks, breaking changes, version bump, changelog draft.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for a pre-publish review, e.g. 'pre-publish review', 'ready to publish?', 'safe to publish'. A plain publish/release request does NOT trigger it.

say_en.text: Run a pre-publish review — is it safe to publish?
say_en.note: Claude will launch the full review and report back.

say_en.text: Please run pre-publish review and check for breaking changes.
say_en.note: Focus on breaking changes and version bump.

say_en.text: Do a pre-release review before I publish tomorrow.
say_en.note: It checks all changes since the last release.
